correctness.rationale: The P3/P4 meet-row reduction and P1/P2 constrain top, bottom, and each atom row. P5 gives exactly a_i->u_i<=u_i and a_i->w<=w. The disjoint bottom cases w=0, w=atom, w=1 yield respectively m+1, m(m+1), and four-colored terminal-or-arrow functional digraph types; the first two sum (m+1)^2. For permutation cycle length d the equivariant choice is four terminal colors plus Fix(sigma^d)-1 other vertex targets, hence 3+sum_{e|d}e c_e; Burnside gives the stated partition sum. Rooted-tree decoration of sinks and directed cycles gives A(z) and C(z). Splitting out d=1 gives a (1-T(z))^{-1} factor; Otter T(z)=1-b sqrt(1-z/rho)+... yields coefficient K rho^{-m}m^{-1/2}. Independent exact Burnside evaluation gives U_2..U_10=(24,66,186,533,1562,4592,13532,39778,116724). These finite values do not prove asymptotics.
